scanNote:
3-UNITNING TO'RTINCHI BETI (21-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Shop till you Drop!' va binafsha-ko'k yorliqda oq '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening' sarlavhasi.
17) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and underline the correct item in bold.' Oltita gap, har birida qalin harfli ikki variant.
18) a) 'Read the article and fill in the headings.' Beshta sarlavha (qiya harflarda): History of the Store; The Sales; Location & Management; Recommendation; Departments & Services.
   b) 'Underline the phrases which best describe pictures 1 - 3, then explain the words in bold.'
19) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: busy, over, took, run, survive, security, heart, Food. Sakkiz nuqtali qator.
20) 'Correct the false statements, as in the example.' 1-gapda ko'k qiya javob berilgan (namuna). 3, 4, 5-gaplar o'ng ustun ostida davom etadi.

O'NG TOMONDA katta TO'Q KO'K fonli maqola:
Sarlavha och sariq qo'lyozma harflarda: '"All Things, for All People, Everywhere"'
O'ng yuqorida Harrods binosining KEChKI surati - butun bino tilla rang chiroqlar bilan yoritilgan.
Matn oq harflarda, besh qismga bo'lingan; har qismning oldida harf va BO'Sh nuqtali qator (a, b, c, d, e).
Matn ichida uchta surat:
• 1 - Harrods kirish eshigi oldida yashil formadagi beshta eshikbon ('Green Men')
• 2 - Food Halls: bezakli javonlarda mevalar va mahsulotlar
• 3 - do'kon oldidagi katta OLOMON (chegirma kuni)
Qalin harfli so'zlar: doormat, celebrated, Chairman, medicines, perfumes, van delivery service, bombings, abroad, spread, employs, staff, fire brigade, security personnel, nurses, official supplier, certain goods, busy, customers, motto, quality, fascinating.

Pastda:
• 'Speaking': a) 'Take notes under the headings in Ex. 18a, then tell the class about Harrods.' b) 'Tell the class about a big department store in your country.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '21'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ HARRODS NIMA:

  Londondagi eng mashhur univermag,
  Knightsbridge tumanida.
  1849-yilda kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni
  sifatida ochilgan.


⚠ SARLAVHA - DO'KON ShIORI:

  'All Things, for All People, Everywhere'
  = Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda.

  ⚠ Bu - 'a motto' (shior). Matnning
  oxirgi qismida shu so'z bor.

  ⚠ Uch qism ham 'ALL' va 'EVERY-'
  bilan - takror ohang beradi.


⚠ MATNNING BESh QISMI (18a javobi):

  a - Location & Management
      (joylashuv va rahbariyat)
  b - History of the Store
      (do'kon tarixi)
  c - Departments & Services
      (bo'limlar va xizmatlar)
  d - The Sales (chegirmalar)
  e - Recommendation (tavsiya)


⚠ RAQAMLAR - DIQQAT BILAN:

  1849  - ochilgan yil
  1983  - chet elga chiqqan yil
  35,000 - kunlik tashrifchi
  300   - bo'limlar soni
  7     - qavatlar
  4,000 - xodimlar
  8     - eshikbonlar
  19    - bar va restoranlar
  300,000 - chegirmaning birinchi kunidagi
            xaridorlar

  ⚠ 17 va 20-mashqlar aynan shu
  raqamlarni tekshiradi.

points.en: [a] "Enter a Different World", it says on the doormat, and this is what you do when you visit Harrods in Knightsbridge, London.
points.uz: [a] "Boshqa dunyoga qadam qo'ying", - deb yozilgan poyandozda, va Londonning Knightsbridge tumanidagi Harrodsga borganingizda aynan shunday bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a doormat' = eshik oldidagi poyandoz.
⚠ 'Enter' - BUYRUQ gapi, predlogsiz:
'enter a world' ('enter INTO' XATO).
⚠ Knightsbridge - 'k' va 'gh' O'QILMAYDI:
/ˈnaɪtsbrɪdʒ/.

points.en: [a] Harrods is "the world's most celebrated store", says Chairman Mr Mohamed Al Fayed.
points.uz: [a] Harrods - "dunyodagi eng mashhur do'kon", - deydi rais janob Muhammad Al Fayed.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "the world's most celebrated" - egalik +
eng yuqori daraja.
⚠ 'celebrated' bu yerda = mashhur (bayram
ma'nosida emas!).
⚠ 'a chairman' = rais, boshqaruv raisi.

points.en: [b] In the beginning, though, Harrods was just a small grocer's shop. It was opened in 1849 and run by Charles Henry Harrod.
points.uz: [b] Ammo boshida Harrods shunchaki kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni edi. U 1849-yilda ochilgan va Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan boshqarilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'though' gap o'rtasida = 'ammo', verguller
bilan.
⚠ 'was opened', 'run' - MAJHUL NISBAT.
⚠ 'to run a shop' = do'kon boshqarmoq
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'run' - noto'g'ri fe'l: run - ran - run.

points.en: [b] His son took over and added medicines and perfumes, as well as fruit, flowers, sweets and a van delivery service.
points.uz: [b] O'g'li ishni qo'lga oldi va dori hamda atirlarni, shuningdek meva, gul, shirinlik va furgonda yetkazib berish xizmatini qo'shdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to take over' = ishni qo'lga olmoq
(13-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek.
⚠ 'a van' = furgon; 'delivery' = yetkazib berish.

points.en: [b] Over the years, Harrods has survived a fire, two World Wars and even two bombings.
points.uz: [b] Yillar davomida Harrods yong'in, ikki jahon urushi va hatto ikki portlashdan omon qolgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'over the years' = yillar davomida
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'to survive' = omon qolmoq - predlogsiz!
'survive from' XATO.
⚠ 'has survived' - PRESENT PERFECT.

points.en: [b] In 1983, Harrods moved abroad and opened a branch in Japan and later others in Hong Kong, Singapore and Taiwan, as well as airport shops in most major European cities.
points.uz: [b] 1983-yilda Harrods chet elga chiqdi va Yaponiyada filial ochdi, keyinroq Gonkong, Singapur va Tayvanda, shuningdek Yevropaning aksar yirik shaharlarida aeroport do'konlarini ochdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'abroad' - PREDLOGSIZ ravish:
'to go abroad' ('to abroad' XATO).
⚠ 'a branch' = filial; shox.
⚠ 'major' = yirik, asosiy.

points.en: [c] Today, around 35,000 people visit Harrods every day. It has got 300 departments spread over seven floors and employs over 4,000 staff.
points.uz: [c] Bugun Harrodsga har kuni taxminan 35 000 kishi tashrif buyuradi. Unda yetti qavatga yoyilgan 300 bo'lim bor va u 4000 dan ortiq xodim ishlatadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to spread' = yoymoq (spread - spread -
spread, o'zgarmaydi).
⚠ 'to employ' = ishga olmoq.
⚠ 'staff' - JAMOA oti, KO'PLIK ma'nosida:
'4,000 staff' ('staffs' XATO).

points.en: [c] It also has eight doormen, known as 'Green Men', as well as its own fire brigade, security personnel, doctors and nurses.
points.uz: [c] Yana sakkizta eshikboni bor - ular 'Yashil odamlar' deb ataladi, shuningdek o'z o't o'chirish bo'limi, qo'riqchilari, shifokorlari va hamshiralari bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a doorman' → ko'plikda 'doorMEN'.
⚠ 'known as' = ... deb tanilgan.
⚠ 'a fire brigade' = o't o'chirish bo'limi.
⚠ 'personnel' - SANALMAYDIGAN, urg'u OXIRIDA:
person-NEL.

points.en: [c] Harrods is the official supplier of certain goods to the Royal Family, and sells everything from clothes to caviar.
points.uz: [c] Harrods qirol oilasiga ayrim mahsulotlarning rasmiy yetkazib beruvchisi va kiyimdan ikragacha hamma narsani sotadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a supplier' = yetkazib beruvchi
('to supply' fe'lidan).
⚠ 'goods' = mahsulotlar - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'certain' bu yerda = ayrim, ba'zi.

points.en: [c] The Food Halls are still the heart and soul of Harrods. In addition to the nineteen bars and restaurants in the store, there is a bank, a travel agent's, a dry cleaner's and the biggest hair and beauty salon in Europe.
points.uz: [c] Oziq-ovqat zallari hamon Harrodsning yuragi va joni. Do'kondagi o'n to'qqizta bar va restorandan tashqari bank, sayohat agentligi, kimyoviy tozalash va Yevropadagi eng katta sartaroshxona bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the heart and soul of' = yuragi va joni
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'in addition to' = ... dan tashqari.
⚠ "a dry cleaner's" = kimyoviy tozalash -
yana egalik shakli (18-betdagi qoida).

points.en: [d] January and July are very busy months for Harrods because they are sale times. Over 300,000 customers visit the store on the first day alone.
points.uz: [d] Yanvar va iyul Harrods uchun juda band oylar, chunki bu chegirma vaqti. Faqat birinchi kunning o'zida 300 000 dan ortiq xaridor do'konga keladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'busy months' - 19-mashqda.
⚠ 'alone' bu yerda = faqat, yolg'iz
('on the first day ALONE' = faqat birinchi
kunning o'zida).
⚠ 'a customer' = xaridor, mijoz.

points.en: [d] Many people sleep outside the store all night to be first in when the doors open on the first day.
points.uz: [d] Ko'p odam birinchi kuni eshiklar ochilganda birinchi bo'lib kirish uchun tun bo'yi do'kon oldida uxlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'outside' - PREDLOGSIZ: 'outside the store'.
⚠ 'to be first in' = birinchi bo'lib kirmoq.
⚠ 'all night' - artiklsiz.

points.en: [e] "All things, for all people, everywhere" is the store's motto. The Harrods name means the best of British quality, service and style.
points.uz: [e] "Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda" - do'konning shiori. Harrods nomi Britaniya sifati, xizmati va uslubining eng yaxshisini anglatadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a motto' = shior. Italyanchadan kirgan;
ko'pligi 'mottoes' yoki 'mottos'.
⚠ "the store's motto" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'quality' - 19-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi.

points.en: [e] All in all, Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
points.uz: [e] Umuman olganda, Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'all in all' = umuman olganda - xulosa
iborasi.
⚠ 'fascinating' = maftunkor (7-betdagi Tailand
matnida ham bor edi).
⚠ 'a place TO VISIT' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the correct item in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va qalin harfli to'g'ri variantning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu maqola o'qiladi -
  mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham to'liq bajarish
  mumkin.

  ⚠ Hamma savol RAQAM yoki NOMGA
  tegishli - matndan aniq topiladi.


⚠ 'AN ITEM':

  = variant, band.
  ⚠ 9-betdagi 16-mashqda ham shu so'z
  ishlatilgan edi: 'circle the correct
  item'.


⚠ RAQAMLARNI TINGLAShDA DIQQAT:

  4,000 = 'four thousand'
  6,000 = 'six thousand'
  300 = 'three hundred'
  3,000 = 'three thousand'

  ⚠ 'thirteen' /ˌθɜːˈtiːn/ va 'thirty'
  /ˈθɜːti/ - urg'u boshqa joyda!
  ⚠ Bu - tinglashda eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan joy.

items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'when you visit Harrods in
KNIGHTSBRIDGE, London'.

⚠ Talaffuzi: /ˈnaɪtsbrɪdʒ/ - 'k' va 'gh'
O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Matnda: 'says CHAIRMAN Mr MOHAMED AL FAYED'.

⚠ Charles Henry Harrod - do'konni 1849-yilda
OChGAN odam, hozirgi rais emas.

⚠ Matnda: 'has survived A FIRE, two World Wars
and even TWO BOMBINGS'.

⚠ Urush IKKITA (2), UChTA emas.

⚠ Matnda: 'employs over 4,000 staff'.

⚠ 'staff' - JAMOA oti, KO'PLIK ma'nosida.
'staffs' XATO.

items.textEn: 5  ___ are the heart and soul of Harrods.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'The FOOD HALLS are still the heart
and soul of Harrods.'

⚠ 2-suratda aynan Food Halls ko'rsatilgan.

⚠ Matnda: 'JANUARY AND JULY are very busy
months ... because they are sale times.'

⚠ Oy nomlari KATTA harf bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and fill in the headings.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SARLAVHA - BESh QISM.

  ⚠ Har qismning BIRINChI GAPI
  sarlavhani ochib beradi.


QANDAY TOPILADI:

  a - 'Harrods in KNIGHTSBRIDGE, London'
      (joylashuv) + 'says CHAIRMAN Mr
      Mohamed Al Fayed' (rahbariyat)
      → Location & Management

  b - 'In the BEGINNING ... It was
      opened in 1849' (tarix)
      → History of the Store

  c - 'It has got 300 DEPARTMENTS ...
      a bank, a travel agent's, a dry
      cleaner's' (bo'limlar va xizmatlar)
      → Departments & Services

  d - 'they are SALE TIMES'
      → The Sales

  e - 'Harrods is a FASCINATING PLACE
      TO VISIT' (tavsiya)
      → Recommendation


⚠ TAVSIYA HAR DOIM OXIRIDA:

  19-betdagi Parij maqolasida ham,
  9-betdagi Susanning xatida ham
  tavsiya OXIRGI qismda edi.

  ⚠ Bu - ingliz maqolasining doimiy
  tuzilishi.


⚠ 'MANAGEMENT':

  = rahbariyat, boshqaruv.
  ⚠ 'to manage' = boshqarmoq
  → 'a manager' = boshqaruvchi
  → 'management' = boshqaruv

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'Harrods in KNIGHTSBRIDGE, London' - joylashuv.
⚠ 'says CHAIRMAN Mr Mohamed Al Fayed' -
rahbariyat.

⚠ 'In the BEGINNING ... It was opened in 1849'.
⚠ Butun qism o'tgan zamonda - tarix belgisi.

⚠ '300 DEPARTMENTS spread over seven floors'.
⚠ 'a bank, a travel agent's, a dry cleaner's,
a hair and beauty salon' - XIZMATLAR.

⚠ 'they are SALE TIMES' va '300,000 customers
visit the store on the first day'.

⚠ 'All in all, Harrods is a FASCINATING PLACE
TO VISIT.'

⚠ Tavsiya HAR DOIM oxirgi qismda.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the phrases which best describe pictures 1 - 3, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 1 - 3 suratlarni eng yaxshi tasvirlaydigan iboralar tagiga chizing, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SURAT - UCh IBORA.


QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLARNING MA'NOSI:

  a doormat    = poyandoz
  celebrated   = mashhur
  a chairman   = rais
  medicines    = dorilar
  perfumes     = atirlar
  a van delivery service = furgonda
                 yetkazib berish xizmati
  a bombing    = portlash, bombardimon
  abroad       = chet elda
  to spread    = yoymoq
  to employ    = ishga olmoq
  staff        = xodimlar
  a fire brigade = o't o'chirish bo'limi
  security personnel = qo'riqchilar
  a nurse      = hamshira
  an official supplier = rasmiy yetkazib
                 beruvchi
  certain goods = ayrim mahsulotlar
  busy         = band
  a customer   = xaridor
  a motto      = shior
  quality      = sifat
  fascinating  = maftunkor


⚠ 'STAFF', 'PERSONNEL', 'GOODS' -
UChALASI HAM G'ALATI OT:

  staff - jamoa oti, ko'plik ma'nosida
     ('4,000 staff', 'staffs' XATO)
  personnel - sanalmaydigan
     ('personnels' XATO)
  goods - HAR DOIM ko'plikda
     ('a good' - boshqa ma'no)


⚠ 'CELEBRATED' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) mashhur (sifat):
     'the world's most celebrated store'
  2) nishonlandi (fe'l, o'tgan zamon):
     'We celebrated my birthday.'

  ⚠ Matnda BIRINChI ma'no.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to RUN a shop      - do'kon boshqarmoq
  his son TOOK over  - o'g'li ishni
                       qo'lga oldi
  OVER the years     - yillar davomida
  to SURVIVE a fire  - yong'indan omon
                       qolmoq
  SECURITY personnel - qo'riqchilar
  the FOOD Halls     - oziq-ovqat zallari
  the HEART and soul of - yuragi va joni
  BUSY months        - band oylar


⚠ 'TO RUN' - KO'P MA'NOLI:

  1) yugurmoq
  2) boshqarmoq (biznes, do'kon)
     'to run a shop/a business/a company'
  3) ishlamoq (mashina)
     'The engine is running.'

  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'l: run - ran - run.


⚠ 'TO TAKE OVER':

  = ishni/lavozimni qo'lga olmoq.
  ⚠ 13-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi:
  'the computers TAKE OVER for the night'.


⚠ 'OVER' - IKKI XIL:

  'OVER the years' = yillar davomida
     (vaqt)
  'over 4,000 staff' = 4000 dan ORTIQ
     (miqdor)

  ⚠ Matnda ikkalasi ham bor.


⚠ 'TO SURVIVE' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  'to survive a fire' ✓
  'to survive FROM a fire' ✗

  ⚠ 'a survivor' = omon qolgan odam.


⚠ 'FOOD HALLS' - KATTA HARF BILAN:

  Bu - Harrodsning ma'lum bo'limi nomi,
  shuning uchun ATOQLI ot kabi katta
  harf bilan yoziladi.
  ⚠ Ro'yxatda ham 'Food' katta harf
  bilan berilgan - bu KATTA yordam.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the false statements, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  1  Harrods is in Paris.
     → "It isn't in Paris. It's in
        London."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM:
     1) INKOR bilan rad etish
     2) TO'G'RI ma'lumotni aytish


⚠ QAYSI FE'L BILAN INKOR:

  Gapdagi FE'LGA qarab:

  'Harrods IS in Paris.'
     → "It ISN'T in Paris."
  'Harrods WAS a big bakery.'
     → "It WASN'T a big bakery."
  'Harrods OPENED a branch...'
     → "It DIDN'T OPEN a branch..."
  'Harrods HAS GOT 3,000 departments.'
     → "It HASN'T GOT 3,000..."
  'THERE ARE nine bars...'
     → "THERE AREN'T nine bars..."

  ⚠ 3-gapda 'did' qo'shilgani uchun
  fe'l ODDIY shaklga qaytadi:
  "didn't OPEN" ('didn't opened' XATO).


TO'G'RI MA'LUMOTLAR (matndan):

  1  London (Paris emas)
  2  a small grocer's shop
     (a big bakery emas)
  3  Japan (Korea emas)
  4  300 departments (3,000 emas)
  5  nineteen bars (nine emas)

  ⚠ 4 va 5-gaplarda RAQAM o'zgartirilgan:
  300 → 3,000 va 19 → 9.
  Bu - eng ko'p uchraydigan tuzoq.
exercises.exampleEn: Harrods is in Paris. - It isn't in Paris. It's in London.
exercises.exampleUz: Harrods Parijda. - U Parijda emas. U Londonda.
modelAnswers: It isn't in Paris. It's in London.
It wasn't a big bakery. It was a small grocer's shop.
It didn't open a branch in Korea. It opened a branch in Japan.
It hasn't got 3,000 departments. It has got 300 departments.
There aren't nine bars and restaurants. There are nineteen.
modelAnswersUz: U katta novvoyxona emas edi. U kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni edi.
U Koreyada filial ochmadi. U Yaponiyada filial ochdi.
Unda 3000 ta bo'lim yo'q. Unda 300 ta bo'lim bor.
To'qqizta bar va restoran emas. O'n to'qqizta.

exercises.instructionEn: a) Take notes under the headings in Ex. 18a, then tell the class about Harrods. b) Tell the class about a big department store in your country.
exercises.instructionUz: a) 18a mashqidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling, so'ng sinfga Harrods haqida gapirib bering. b) Sinfga o'z mamlakatingizdagi katta univermag haqida gapirib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLIB GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Sarlavhalar 18a mashqidan olinadi -
  ya'ni maqolaning tuzilishi gapirishning
  ham rejasi bo'ladi.


BESh SARLAVHA VA QAYDLAR bandlarda
berilgan.


⚠ b) QISMI - O'Z MAMLAKATINGIZ HAQIDA:

  Xuddi shu besh sarlavha bo'yicha
  gapiring:
     1) qayerda, kim boshqaradi
     2) qachon ochilgan
     3) qanday bo'limlar va xizmatlar
     4) chegirmalar qachon
     5) tavsiya

  ⚠ Bu - 'transfer' mashqi: o'rganilgan
  qolipni O'Z hayotingizga qo'llash.
  Aynan shu bosqichda til HAQIQATAN
  o'zlashtiriladi.


⚠ FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:

  'It is located in ...'
  'It was opened in [yil].'
  'It has got ... departments.'
  'It employs over ... staff.'
  'The sales are in ...'
  'It is a fascinating place to visit.'

points.en: Location & Management: Knightsbridge, London; Chairman - Mr Mohamed Al Fayed
points.uz: Joylashuv va rahbariyat: Knightsbridge, London; rais - janob Muhammad Al Fayed
points.noteUz:
⚠ Gap: 'Harrods is in Knightsbridge, London.
The Chairman is Mr Mohamed Al Fayed.'

points.en: History of the Store: opened in 1849 by Charles Henry Harrod as a small grocer's shop; his son took over; survived a fire, two World Wars and two bombings; went abroad in 1983
points.uz: Do'kon tarixi: 1849-yilda Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni sifatida ochilgan; o'g'li ishni qo'lga oldi; yong'in, ikki jahon urushi va ikki portlashdan omon qolgan; 1983-yilda chet elga chiqqan
points.noteUz:
⚠ Zamon: PAST SIMPLE va PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'has survived' - natijasi hozir ham bor.

points.en: Departments & Services: 35,000 visitors a day; 300 departments on seven floors; over 4,000 staff; eight doormen ('Green Men'); own fire brigade, security personnel, doctors and nurses; official supplier to the Royal Family; nineteen bars and restaurants; a bank, a travel agent's, a dry cleaner's, the biggest hair and beauty salon in Europe
points.uz: Bo'limlar va xizmatlar: kuniga 35 000 tashrifchi; yetti qavatda 300 bo'lim; 4000 dan ortiq xodim; sakkiz eshikbon ('Yashil odamlar'); o'z o't o'chirish bo'limi, qo'riqchilari, shifokorlari va hamshiralari; qirol oilasiga rasmiy yetkazib beruvchi; o'n to'qqiz bar va restoran; bank, sayohat agentligi, kimyoviy tozalash, Yevropadagi eng katta sartaroshxona
points.noteUz:
⚠ Eng UZUN qism - eng ko'p RAQAM shu yerda.
⚠ 17 va 20-mashqlar aynan shu raqamlarni
tekshiradi.

points.en: The Sales: January and July; over 300,000 customers on the first day; people sleep outside all night
points.uz: Chegirmalar: yanvar va iyul; birinchi kuni 300 000 dan ortiq xaridor; odamlar tun bo'yi tashqarida uxlaydi
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a sale' = chegirma savdosi.
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnida ham chegirmalar
haqida edi.

points.en: Recommendation: 'All things, for all people, everywhere' - the store's motto; Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
points.uz: Tavsiya: 'Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda' - do'konning shiori; Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'all in all' = umuman olganda - xulosani
boshlash iborasi.
⚠ 'a place to visit' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

points.en: Tell the class about a big department store in your country: where it is, when it opened, what departments and services it has, when the sales are, and why people should visit it.
points.uz: Sinfga o'z mamlakatingizdagi katta univermag haqida gapiring: u qayerda, qachon ochilgan, qanday bo'lim va xizmatlari bor, chegirmalar qachon va nima uchun u yerga borish kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'TRANSFER' mashqi: qolipni O'Z hayotingizga
qo'llash.

⚠ Foydali qoliplar: 'It is located in ...',
'It was opened in ...', 'It has got ...
departments.'

patterns.exampleEn: It was opened in 1849 and run by Charles Henry Harrod.
patterns.exampleUz: U 1849-yilda ochilgan va Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan boshqarilgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT: 'was opened' + 'by'.
⚠ Bu 9-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

patterns.formula: It has got [son] departments and employs over [son] staff.
patterns.exampleEn: It has got 300 departments and employs over 4,000 staff.
patterns.exampleUz: Unda 300 bo'lim bor va 4000 dan ortiq xodim ishlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'over' bu yerda = ... dan ortiq.
⚠ 'staff' - KO'PLIK ma'nosida, 'staffs' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: Harrods has survived a fire and two bombings.
patterns.exampleUz: Harrods yong'in va ikki portlashdan omon qolgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to survive' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT - natijasi hozir ham bor.

patterns.exampleEn: It isn't in Paris. It's in London.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Noto'g'ri gapni to'g'rilashning IKKI QADAMI:
avval INKOR, keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

patterns.formula: All in all, [nima] is a fascinating place to visit.
patterns.exampleEn: All in all, Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
patterns.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'all in all' - xulosani boshlash iborasi.
⚠ 'a place TO VISIT' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.
